_doc: Capital, Media & Institutions — funds, data houses, alliances. Keyed by cleaned-name token; see ENRICHMENT_PROMPT.md.

breakthrough energy ventures.one_liner: Bill Gates-founded climate fund; backs battery & materials startups.

benchmark mineral intelligence.one_liner: Price-reporting agency & data house for the battery supply chain.

bloombergnef.one_liner: Clean-energy research & data on batteries, storage and EVs.

global battery alliance.one_liner: WEF-hosted alliance behind the Battery Passport standard.

international electrotechnical.one_liner: Geneva-based international body setting electrical/electronic standards, including battery safety (IEC 62133).

underwriters laboratories.one_liner: US safety-certification organization; battery standards include UL 2580 (EV) and UL 1973 (stationary storage).

society of automotive.one_liner: US standards body (SAE International) publishing automotive and EV engineering standards.

eurobat.one_liner: Brussels-based association representing European automotive and industrial battery manufacturers.

european battery alliance.one_liner: EU-backed industrial initiative to build a competitive European battery supply chain.

international energy agency.one_liner: Paris-based intergovernmental organization; publishes the annual Global EV Outlook.

u.s. department of energy.one_liner: US government agency; funds battery R&D including the ReCell Center and Battery500 consortium.

goldman sachs.one_liner: US investment bank active in battery and EV sector financing and research.

morgan stanley.one_liner: US investment bank publishing widely-cited EV/battery sector research.

softbank vision fund.one_liner: Technology investment fund of Japan's SoftBank Group; has backed various EV/mobility startups.

volta energy.one_liner: US venture fund investing specifically in battery and energy-storage technology.

reuters.one_liner: International news wire (part of Thomson Reuters) with dedicated energy/EV coverage.

electrek.one_liner: US news site focused on electric vehicles and clean energy.

insideevs.one_liner: US EV-focused news and reviews site.

wood mackenzie.one_liner: UK energy research and consulting firm (part of Verisk).

fastmarkets.one_liner: UK price-reporting agency covering battery raw materials.

idtechex.one_liner: UK market-research firm covering emerging technologies including batteries and EVs.
